name: Jurnie
description:
Jurnie captures your meetings and turns them into structured, searchable memory.

This connector brings that memory into Claude. Ask what happened in a specific meeting, pull the exact wording from a transcript, or find what a client said about pricing three months ago.

It works across conversations, not just inside one. Every person, company, project and topic gets a profile built from the meetings that mention them, so you can ask what you know about a company before a call. Commitments and decisions carry state, so you can ask what's still open, what's overdue, or whether a decision has since been reversed.

Teams share meetings through teamspaces, each with its own memory. Claude sees exactly what you can see: your own meetings, anything shared with you, and the teamspaces you belong to.

Every tool is read-only. This connector never writes to your Jurnie workspace.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Jurnie to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Jurnie to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.jurnie.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Jurnie MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Jurnie provides these MCP tools: get_meeting_summary, get_meeting_transcript, list_meetings, search_memory_claims, and search_memory_entities.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Jurnie?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Jurnie in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Jurnie requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Jurnie is developed by Jurnie. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
